history.position: THIS COURSE TEACHES NO REPAIR HISTORY. The lead's decisions on the engine (interest method and grace as required inputs, the Kenya clause as printed, the PSC tax reading stated, the Norwegian agreement cited from its Wayback capture) landed before its merge and before any lesson was written; that is provenance.

regulatoryRule: Every Act, model contract, accounting agreement and guide taught is named with its edition or gazette date and the date read (2026-09-26), printed in digest section 2 and asserted against the vendored FINDINGS-jointVenture.md. Every quotation is in concepts.json with its citation and is verified against the public text by quote_check.py (the PDFs hash to the sha256 prefix FINDINGS records). The Norwegian agreement (an unofficial English translation, cited from the Wayback capture of 26 May 2024), the Kenya Model PSC 2015, the PIA 2021 gazette, World Bank Briefing Note 8, IMF FARI TNM/16/01, IMF WP/24/89 and OpenOil (CC) are public and quoted with citation; the AIPN model JOA, COPAS and AAPL forms are licensed and never quoted. No legal figure is invented: PIA s.85(4)(a) 60% and s.85(4)(c) development and production only are cited; every contractual rate, tolerance, scale, multiple and share is a required input with no default.

openReadings.PSC tax: income tax is charged on the contractor's profit oil share, as FARI TNM/16/01 and World Bank Note 8 assume. Never graded: every field bit-identical under reading_psc_tax_all_costs (joa_capstone.mjs, discriminate.mjs).
openReadings.grace: a default cured within the stated grace carries no interest; one cured later carries interest from the due date, as the Kenya Model PSC 2015 Art. 6.7 prints. Never graded: bit-identical under reading_grace_delays_interest.
openReadings.cover: the non-defaulting parties cover in proportion to their paying interests (a carried party pays none). Never graded: bit-identical under reading_cover_by_participating.
openReadings.limit base: a required input with no default (costOilLimitBase), taught as a stated input and no reading.

scopeSeams.ledger arithmetic, discounting and NPV: OWNED BY the cashflow course; this course imports the canonical npv and applyPSC and refers there.
scopeSeams.fiscal regime design: OWNED BY the fiscal course (royalty, profit share and tax as design levers).
scopeSeams.the Nigerian fiscal system: OWNED BY the pia course; this course teaches only the Act's carried interest provision (s.85(4)) and quotes s.85(2) and s.311(2)(a)(iii).
scopeSeams.portfolio choice and the field developme: OWNED BY the portfolio and fdp courses.

namingCollisions.interest: always qualified: participating, paying, beneficial or carried interest; default interest for money charged on a late payment.
namingCollisions.carry: a carried party's cost share paid by its carriers; a pool, credit or balance is 'carried forward' or 'carried to' a named period.
namingCollisions.recovery: always of something named: carry recovery, premium recovery, cost recovery (PSC).
namingCollisions.premium: the stated multiple of a non-consenting party's proportionate share of an operation's cost.
namingCollisions.cash call: the operator's monthly request for advances; an adjustment is an earlier month's difference applied to a later call.
namingCollisions.overhead: the operator's charge on a stated scale over a stated base.

plan.state: FOUNDATION: structure, digest, capstones, fields, precision, truth, panels, learning page, gates, writer briefs. Stops before lessons.

fieldsDiscrimination.idumu_zed_paying_pct: paying and beneficial swapped, the carry spread over every party, the carry in equal shares, the carry taken in full
fieldsDiscrimination.idumu_zed_june_call: paying and beneficial swapped, the under-call not carried, the carry over every party, the lag two months
fieldsDiscrimination.idumu_zed_august_paid: arrears not billed, the adjustment not carried, paying and beneficial swapped, the threshold dropped
fieldsDiscrimination.idumu_budget_allowed_overrun: the higher of the two, the percentage of the actual total, the reference text's five percent
fieldsDiscrimination.idumu_operating_overhead: exclusions ignored (overhead on the wrong base), each band's rate on the whole base, the whole base at its band's rate, the first band's rate
fieldsDiscrimination.idumu_development_overhead: each band's rate on the whole base, the rate above the bands on the whole base, the first band's rate, the part above the last band dropped
fieldsDiscrimination.okwelle_2031_carry_balance: carry recovered without uplift, uplift on the year's new cost, the recovery share ignored, the carried cost on the paying interest
fieldsDiscrimination.okwelle_backin_refund_to_pra: exploration refunded, the refund on the target interest, bonus, interest and markup refunded, the refund in equal parts
fieldsDiscrimination.okwelle_default_interest: simple interest in place of monthly compounding, the monthly rate as the annual rate, the remaining days dropped, the value date counted
fieldsDiscrimination.okwelle_default_cover_oko: cover in equal shares (default not pro rata), the defaulter left in the cover base, the whole share of the call covered
fieldsDiscrimination.okwelle_prb_june_call: the adjustment not carried, paying and beneficial swapped, the lag one month, a negative call refunded
fieldsDiscrimination.okwelle_2032_cost_recovered: a gross limit applied to revenue after royalty, the opening pool left out, the year's costs recovered whole
fieldsDiscrimination.abiama_spb_premium: premium on the whole cost, premium on the consenting parties' cost (premium on the wrong base), the premium above the cost alone
fieldsDiscrimination.abiama_spb_2036_receipt: reversion a period late, deductions not taken off, premium on the whole cost, premium on the consenting parties' cost
fieldsDiscrimination.abiama_buy_in_to_spa: the buy-in apportioned over 100, premium on the whole cost, the buy-in in equal parts
fieldsDiscrimination.abiama_spa_carry_npv: the NPV a year early, carry recovered without uplift, the entitlement on the paying interest, paying and beneficial swapped
fieldsDiscrimination.abiama_2035_government_profit_oil: a year's own contractor share ignored, a gross limit applied to revenue after royalty, the opening pool left out, the limit base swapped
fieldsDiscrimination.abiama_abo_after_forfeiture_pct: the forfeited interest over every party, in equal parts, to the operator alone
